primary_unique_math_proof: Translate the target hexagon center to (2,0): four centers then coincide with source (0,0),(4,0),(1,sqrt(3)),(3,sqrt(3)); move source (2,0) to (1,-sqrt(3)) and source (2,2sqrt(3)) to (3,-sqrt(3)). One move is impossible: leaving five source centers retains at least two vertices of the side-4 corner triangle, hence a diameter pair of the target hexagon of circumradius2; its midpoint fixes the center, and direct substitution leaves at most four coincident centers. The saved exhaustive pair-isometry audit checks every oriented source/target center pair and finds max overlap4. Therefore minimum moves2.
